description:
Deployment-manager's release pipeline currently returns free-text error messages for every failure mode (missing LPBS config, un-gated commit, cloud unhealthy, readiness gates, build failure, publish failure, verify mismatch). An agent calling `releases start` gets a human-readable string but no structured code, and no hint of what command to run next. Operators who don't deeply know the system can't self-serve recovery.

This is the foundation for the preflight endpoint and skill-guided remediation follow-ups. Without typed errors, the skill can't reliably detect a failure mode and propose the right fix.

Scope of work:
- Introduce a typed error shape used across every orchestrator step and LPBS readiness gate:
  {code, message, remediation_hint, remediation_command}
- Enumerate the error code set. Minimum: missing_lpbs_config, approvals_blocked, cloud_unhealthy, cloud_unreachable, readiness_storage_unconfigured, readiness_app_missing, readiness_remote_profile_missing, build_failed, publish_failed, verify_mismatch, release_in_flight. Workshop decides final naming + whether to split build_failed per-reason.
- Orchestrator steps (deployLoadProfile, deployCheckCloudHealth, deployCheckLPBSReadiness, deployValidateAndSign, deployBuildBinaries, deployPackageAndInstall, publishToLPBS, deployVerifyUpdateEndpoints) emit typed errors.
- LPBS `/deploy-readiness` response gains per-gate `remediation_command` template so DM can surface it unchanged.
- OrchestrationStep gains a structured Error field (currently `error string`) OR a parallel Code field — workshop decides.
- releases/handlers.go `Start` and orchestrator response include the typed error code for each failed step.
- CLI `releases get`, `releases verify`, and `releases start` render remediation hints below the step trace in human mode.
- Full test coverage: every error code exercised via orchestrator test or handler test.

Out of scope:
- The preflight endpoint (separate item).
- Skill rewrite to consume these codes (separate item).
- Auto-fixing errors on behalf of the operator.
name: deployment-manager-release-typed-remediation-errors
title: Typed Remediation Errors Across Release Orchestrator
